monolith-ctrl.note: byte-identical clone of `monolith`: the noise-floor control

ros-4node.note: four-node chain (acquisition -> preprocessing -> inference -> postprocessing), one process each. The inference node owns the decode/threshold step, so compare `infer + post` against the monolith's two buckets. Prerequisite: `cd ws && colcon build --symlink-install`.
ros-4node.shell: source {repo}/ws/install/setup.bash && PYTHONPATH={repo}/monolith/yolocar/src:$PYTHONPATH ros2 launch yolocar_ros bench.launch.py duration:={duration} loops:={loops} source:={source} rotate:={rotate} records:={out}/records.jsonl summary:={out}/summary.json log_level:=WARNING
